name: Spain
title: Holidays in Spain
intro: Beaches, islands, food and city breaks a short flight away. Here's where to go on holiday in Spain, and the best time to visit each.
seo_title: Where to go in Spain: the best places for a holiday

faqs.question: Where in Spain is warm in winter?
faqs.answer: Tenerife, in the Canary Islands, stays mild all year and is at its best from October to March.

faqs.question: Where in Spain is good in summer?
faqs.answer: Asturias, on the green north coast, is cooler than the south in July and August. Menorca is lovely in June and September.

faqs.question: Where should we go for a city break in Spain?
faqs.answer: Barcelona and Valencia both have a beach as well as plenty to see, and work well in three to five nights.
